metadata.summary: Hörsaalzentrum 024 is a procedurally generated five-story campus building (levels 0-4) with about 5,011 m² across 152 spaces, 116 of them rooms. It combines offices, labs, seminar rooms, a lecture hall, a makerspace, a canteen and a library. It holds 944 assets, including 9 machines (8 3D printers and 1 laser cutter). Three lifts and three staircases serve every level, and step-free coverage is 100%.
key_facts: 5 floors (levels 0-4), each 3.8 m high and about 1,002 m²
152 spaces, 116 of them rooms; total area 5,011.2 m²
Lab equipment includes 37 lab benches, 29 microscopes, 23 oscilloscope stations and 18 fume hoods
3 lifts (step-free) and 3 staircases connect all levels
Two entrances, both on the ground floor

stats.name: Hörsaalzentrum 024
stats.attribution: Procedurally generated for the Munich hackathon (CC0)

floors.name: Ground floor
floors.description: Ground floor (level 0) with 2 entrances, 28 spaces and 20 rooms. It has a lobby, a lecture hall (90.6 m²), a canteen, a makerspace, a lab, offices, a kitchen, a meeting room, a seminar room, a print room and storage. It holds 6 machines, including 5 3D printers.

floors.name: Floor 1
floors.description: Floor 1 has 31 spaces and 24 rooms. It is lab-heavy (178.8 m²) with offices, meeting rooms, a seminar room, a library, a kitchen, a print room and storage. Equipment includes lab benches and microscopes.

floors.name: Floor 2
floors.description: Floor 2 has 31 spaces and 24 rooms. It has large seminar room space (150.78 m²), offices, labs, a kitchen and a print room. It has 3 machines, plus oscilloscope stations, microscopes and fume hoods.

floors.name: Floor 3
floors.description: Floor 3 has 31 spaces and 24 rooms. It is mostly offices (319.44 m²) and seminar rooms (148.68 m²), with a smaller lab, a print room, storage and a kitchen. Projectors are among its equipment.

floors.name: Floor 4
floors.description: Floor 4 has 31 spaces and 24 rooms. It has offices, labs (146.82 m²), the most storage of any floor (85.26 m²), seminar and meeting rooms, a print room and a kitchen.
